methodology.pause_proxy: continuous below-threshold frame runs inside the audible span; not text-aligned punctuation pauses
methodology.speaking_rate: normalized reference words divided by the span from first to last audible frame
methodology.warning: Descriptive deterministic proxies only. Admission thresholds require matched human-speech calibration and do not establish naturalness.
